description: This file defines the OutpostsBucketArn class in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing an S3 Outposts bucket ARN with methods to parse, validate, and access components of the ARN.

classes.name: OutpostsBucketArn
classes.description: Represents an S3 Outposts bucket ARN, capable of parsing and validating its structure.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string into an associative array of its components.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the bucket name component of the ARN.

methods.name: getOutpostId
methods.description: Returns the Outpost ID component of the ARN.

methods.name: parseOutpostData
methods.description: Internal method to parse resource-specific data from the ARN.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the components of the ARN against expected values and formats.
